fixture_provenance.policy: Generated locally; no private footage or downloaded evaluation corpus.
fixture_provenance.video: Pinned OpenReel FFmpeg generates test patterns, solid colors, and sine audio.
fixture_provenance.speech: Windows SAPI creates local speech fixtures from checked-in text and SSML.
fixture_provenance.media_cache: Derived transcript, silence, and scene data are content-addressed by SHA-256.
fixture_provenance.time_base: All scoring uses exact integer source or project frames.

tasks.name: split-and-delete
tasks.prompt: Split the first clip at frame 30, then delete the second clip as it existed before any edits.

tasks.name: silence-gap removal
tasks.prompt: Remove every silent gap at least 20 source frames long. Keep all spoken content and butt the remaining clips together.

tasks.name: filler-word removal
tasks.prompt: Use the transcript to remove the filler words. Preserve all other spoken words and close the gaps.

tasks.name: scene-cut
tasks.prompt: Split the clip at every detected scene change with confidence at least 1000 basis points.

tasks.name: effect-and-transition
tasks.prompt: Brighten the second clip by 20 percent and add a 12-frame crossfade into it.

tasks.name: ordinal-resolution stress
tasks.prompt: Resolve all ordinals against the initial timeline: split the first clip at frame 30, delete the second clip, close the resulting timeline gap, then brighten the third clip by 15 percent.

tasks.name: flagship rough cut
tasks.prompt: Assemble a rough cut from the media pool. Use take-A's content first, then take-C, then take-D. Do not use take-B or take-E. Cut dead air at least 20 source frames long and remove recognized filler words. Butt every resulting clip together with no gaps. The brief is explicit; do not choose alternate takes.
